area: Meydan Horizon (overlooking Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary)
_note: Read 17 September 2026 from prestigeone.ae. No form was filled - the site's 'Register for interest' and the /project-documents page ask for name, email and phone, and I did not touch them. Two families of image are excluded as page furniture, not project media: /assets/images/v3/amenities-sliders/... which are stock views of Dubai landmarks (Burj Khalifa, Palm Jumeirah, the airport) used as a location strip on every project page, and /assets/project-featured-images/sliders/... which are thumbnail cards advertising OTHER projects at the foot of the page. Every render on this site carries a PRESTIGE ONE watermark. The page states B+G+2P+20+R, 1-, 2- and 3-bedroom. I downloaded and LOOKED at the exteriors and several interiors. FILENAME WARNING 1: sanctuary-aprtment.webp is NOT an apartment interior - it is a wide aerial EXTERIOR of the whole tower in its creek-side setting. FILENAME WARNING 2: sanctuary-hive-2.webp is published on this residential page but it shows a DIFFERENT building - Sanctuary Hive, which prestigeone.ae lists separately as a commercial office scheme. The two projects also share gallery files (gym, kids play area, rooftop pool, residential lobby all appear on both pages), so do not treat a shared file as evidence about either one. No floor plans are published as images.
